_comment: Same bico transfer as text_rebase_t5base_flant5large_bico_hubcheckpoint.json, but the target head is trained from scratch (linear_probe_head) after transport, on the same support set (method_params.shots_per_class examples per class, same seed) bico uses for its own bilinear statistics -- no build_nearest_mean_head.py step needed. Do NOT set target_task_heads alongside linear_probe_head, they're mutually exclusive.
_source_base_UNVERIFIED: source_model_name_or_path is google-t5/t5-base (original T5, not t5-v1_1-base) because varun-v-rao/t5-base-snli's model name implies that base.
_source_input_template: varun-v-rao/t5-base-snli expects a single formatted string, not this repo's default tokenizer(premise, hypothesis) pair encoding -- confirmed with scripts/probe_nli_input_format.py. A-only: B still uses the default pair encoding.
